name: draft-buffer
description: The researcher's own draft box: create, revise, submit, read, review as the namespace reviewer, and mark a draft promoted to a domain candidate.
notes: Only the submitter may update or submit a draft; only a configured namespace reviewer may accept or reject one. review_draft and mark_promoted are here because a researcher is the first-stage reviewer of their own namespace, not because the kit assumes they are the Project Owner: the second stage (candidate_review/formalize) is not reachable from this card at all.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a Mapping or Wiki draft under a stable idempotency key. Trusted host must inject the authenticated actor identity; actor_id is not a client argument.

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Update a draft owned by the authenticated submitter while it is editable. Trusted host must inject the authenticated actor identity; actor_id is not a client argument.

tools.name: submit_draft
tools.description: Freeze the exact TerminusDB commit for human review. Trusted host must inject the authenticated actor identity; actor_id is not a client argument.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List drafts visible in the caller's authorized namespace. Trusted host must inject the authenticated actor identity; actor_id is not a client argument.

tools.name: read_draft
tools.description: Read draft metadata and current or submitted-commit content. Trusted host must inject the authenticated actor identity; actor_id is not a client argument.

tools.name: review_draft
tools.description: Accept or reject a submitted draft as its configured namespace reviewer. Trusted host must inject the authenticated actor identity; actor_id is not a client argument.

tools.name: mark_promoted
tools.description: Record the exact candidate ID and commit created by a domain MCP caller. Trusted host must inject the authenticated actor identity; actor_id is not a client argument.
